
RESTORE-ARCHITECTURE-NOTE
Restore soft-deleted architecture note by stable ID (undeletes item and clears deletedAt timestamp)

USAGE
  fspec restore-architecture-note <workUnitId> <index>

ARGUMENTS
  <workUnitId> (required)
    Work unit ID
  <index> (required)
    Architecture note ID (stable index from show-work-unit or show-deleted)

OPTIONS
  No options available

EXAMPLES
  1. Restore deleted architecture note with ID 2
  $ fspec restore-architecture-note AUTH-001 2
  ✓ Restored architecture note from AUTH-001
Architecture note reappears at index [2] in show-work-unit

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec remove-architecture-note
  fspec show-work-unit
  fspec show-deleted
  fspec compact-work-unit

NOTES
  • Uses stable IDs that never shift when items are removed
  • Restoring an already-active item is idempotent (succeeds with message)
  • Non-existent IDs will fail with clear error message
